items.title: Dave Pell interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 11, 1996
items.q: My name is Monk Rowe, and it’s a great pleasure to have Dave Pell with us.

ctx.x: Saxophonist and band leader Dave Pell has had a variety of jobs in the music world. A native of New York, he was born in 1925 and made the move to the west coast in the late 40s. Dave was employed by Bob Crosby and Les Brown, learning skills that would enable him to lead the very successful Dave Pell Octet. This ensemble found a commercial niche in the jazz market and featured sidemen included Benny Carter, Pepper Adams and Art Pepper. He has worked as a producer for a number of record labels, and his photography…
Dave was interviewed by Monk Rowe before a performance by The Prez Conference at the Sarasota Jazz Festival on April 11, 1996.

We are filming today for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. My name is Monk Rowe, and it’s a great pleasure to have Dave Pell with us. Saxophonist and photographer, record producer, publisher. All of those things.
